subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every new student at Hill School receives a guide written by older students.”?
options: It does not only list rules.
Soon, the class made a watering list.
One student said password rules were annoying.
After that, the team made a checking list.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「It does not only list rules.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Soon, the class made a watering list.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One student said password rules were annoying.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After that, the team made a checking list.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It does not only list rules.」，答案為「It does not only list rules.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It does not only list rules.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
